comum.erro_arranque: The game could not open. Close it and open it again.
confirmar.recomecar: Restart this puzzle? The stones you placed come off; the ones it came with stay.
regra.equilibrio: Half and half in every row and column. Never three alike.
regra.juntas: Links too: = same colour, ≠ different colours.
regra.contra_espelho: As in Balance. Across the axis, the opposite colour.
aviso.metade: More than half is one colour
aviso.espelho: The axis asks for the opposite
regras.toque: Tap a cell to place a black stone. Tap again to turn it white, and once more to take it off.
regras.equilibrio: Every row and column has as many black stones as white. Never three stones of the same colour in a row, across or down.
regras.dadas: Stones with a groove come already set and cannot be moved.
regras.juntas: Links: between two cells, the = sign asks for the same colour and the × sign asks for different colours.
regras.contra_espelho: Mirror: an axis runs through the middle of the grid. Every stone is the opposite colour of the one facing it across the axis.
regras.avisos: When a rule is broken, the stones involved get an outline. You can turn the warnings off in Settings.
pista.tres: With the other colour, there would be three alike in a row.
pista.junta_igual: The link beside it asks for the same colour.
pista.junta_diferente: The link beside it asks for different colours.
pista.espelho: Across the axis sits the opposite colour.
pista.orla: The border takes half of each colour, and this one is already full.
pista.linha: However this {onde} is completed, this colour goes here.
pista.hipotese: With the other colour, a few stones later, a rule would break.
pista.generica: This is the next right stone.
pista.gratis: A little help on the house. It does not count as a hint.
pista.sem_stock: You have no hints. In the shop you trade chips for hints, and you earn one every 7 days in a row.
comojogar.base: Tap a cell to place a stone; tap again to change colour. In every row and column, place half of each colour and never three alike in a row.
comojogar.juntas: Links: between two cells, = asks for the same colour and × asks for different colours.
comojogar.contra_espelho: Mirror: across the axis, every stone is the opposite colour of its counterpart.
comojogar.pistas: A hint reveals a right cell or points out a misplaced stone.
resultado.praca_completa: The {mes} square is complete. The motif has lit up and the month's frame is yours. +{lascas} chips.
resultado.largo_completo: Plaza complete: {pacote}. The motif has lit up.
praca.vazia: The square grows one tile a day. Solve today's puzzle to lay the first.
arquivo.mes_gratis: The current month is always free.
arquivo.mes_bloqueado: The {mes} {ano} dailies open all at once and stay yours.
arquivo.vazio: No past days yet. The archive fills up with time.
loja.pendente: Payment pending. Once it is confirmed, the item is yours.
loja.tempo_limite: The shop took too long to answer. You can go back and try later.
loja.erro: The purchase did not go through. You can try again whenever you like.
loja.lascas_insuficientes: You are {n} chips short. You earn them by solving puzzles: {diario} for the daily puzzle.
loja.pistas_info: Hints are traded for chips only. Every 7 days in a row earns you one.
loja.kit_aviso: You already have {partes}. The price is the same and you get what is missing.
loja.restaurar_nada: There are no purchases to restore.
loja.restaurar_sem_rede: No connection. The purchases we already knew about stay; try again when online.
loja.apoio_obrigado: Thank you. You help Companha make the next game.
loja.apoio_creditos: Put my name in the credits
artigo.PEDRA-BASALTO.desc: The stone as always: dark basalt and pale limestone.
artigo.PEDRA-CALCARIO-ROSA.desc: Pinkish limestone, like that of some southern squares.
artigo.PEDRA-SEIXO-RIO.desc: Stones rolled by the water, with soft edges.
artigo.PEDRA-AZULEJO.desc: Glazed stones, with the shine of azulejo tile.
artigo.PAL-LISBOA.desc: The base colours: basalt, limestone and the pale tone of whitewash.
artigo.PAL-ALTO-CONTRASTE.desc: Black and white as distinct as possible. Included for everyone.
artigo.PAL-DALTONISMO.desc: A pair of colours made for those who find colours hard to tell apart. Included for everyone.
artigo.PAL-ANIL.desc: Indigo blue and sand, like an afternoon by the river.
artigo.PAL-OCRE.desc: Ochre and earth, like the houses of the Alentejo.
artigo.MOLD-ONDAS.desc: A frame of waves around the square.
artigo.MOLD-CORDA.desc: The sailors' rope, in stone, around the square.
artigo.MOLD-AAAA-MM.desc: Earned by completing the {mes} {ano} square. Not for sale.
artigo.PISTA-1.desc: Shows the next right stone and the rule that asks for it.
artigo.PISTA-5.desc: Five hints. Each shows the next right stone and the rule that asks for it.
artigo.PISTA-15.desc: Fifteen hints. Each shows the next right stone and the rule that asks for it.
artigo.PAC-ROSSIO.desc: 20 puzzles to begin with, and the first plaza to pave.
artigo.PAC-CHIADO.desc: 20 puzzles and a new plaza to pave, stone by stone.
artigo.PAC-RIBEIRA.desc: 20 puzzles by the river, and a new plaza to pave.
artigo.ARQ-AAAA-MM.desc: The {mes} {ano} dailies, to play whenever you like. They stay yours.
artigo.ARQ-TUDO.desc: Every month of the archive at once. They also open one by one, with chips.
artigo.KIT-CALCETEIRO.desc: The Chiado pack, the Marble stone and the Indigo palette. Each can also be earned by playing.
artigo.APOIO-COMPANHA.desc: Gives nothing in the game: only our thanks and, if you like, your name in the credits.
artigo.SEM-ANUNCIOS.desc: Removes the ads between games. Hints and undo keep working.
definicoes.avisos_desc: Outlines the stones that break a rule. It never says whether a stone is right.
creditos.texto: Pedra a Pedra is made by Companha, a studio of games made by many hands.
tutorial.p1_toque: Tap to place a stone. Tap again to change it.
tutorial.p1_regra: Every row and column: as many black as white.
tutorial.p2_regra: Never three of the same colour in a row.
tutorial.p1_revela: It was a picture. Every puzzle hides one.
tutorial.p2_forcada: This cell can only take one colour.
tutorial.p3: Now it is up to you. No rush.
tutorial.desfazer: Changed your mind? Undo takes it back.
tutorial.fim: You know the essentials. {n} hints are waiting for when you need them. Today's puzzle is waiting for you.
tutorial.rever_corpo: Your progress stays as it is.
intro.titulo: There is a new rule today.
intro.juntas: Links: = asks for the same colour, × asks for different colours.
intro.contra_espelho: Mirror: across the axis, the opposite colour.
gravacao.versao_nova: This save comes from a newer version. Update the app to continue your progress.
gravacao.recuperada: We recovered your progress from the last backup. You may be missing your last move.
gravacao.perdida: We could not read your progress. We started fresh; purchases come back with Restore purchases.
gravacao.parcial: Part of your progress could not be read and was reset.
calc.nome_invalido: The name must have between 3 and 16 letters.
calc.nao_copiou: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it by hand.
calc.sem_spoilers: The code only carries numbers from your progress. Never puzzles or solutions.
calc.erro.cheia: The list is full. Remove a friend to add another.
calc.erro.antigo: You already have a newer code from this friend.
calc.remover_confirmar: Remove this friend from the list?
tutorial.saltar_feito: Done. The tutorial waits for you in Settings.
tutorial.saltar_confirmar: Want to skip? No problem. You can come back to it whenever you like.
oficio.mestre: You have reached the top of the craft.
oficio.explica: Every puzzle you solve without a hint earns points: 1 if easy, 2 if medium, 3 if hard. You never lose points.
oficio.desc.n2: Solve a medium technique without a hint
oficio.desc.n3: Solve a hard technique without a hint
oficio.subiu_desc: The craft shows in the hand. {lascas} chips and a seal for your square.
oficio.a11y_barra: Craft: {nivel}, {n} points. Tap to see what is left.
objetivos.hoje_vazio: That is all for today. Tomorrow brings more.
objetivos.desaparece: Any left over pass at no cost.
obj.H2: Lay today's puzzle without a hint.
obj.H5: Lay a medium or hard puzzle.
obj.H6: Try a different rule from yesterday's.
obj.S1: Five daily puzzles without a hint.
obj.S2: Three days in a row in the square.
obj.S6: Two puzzles from the same pack.
obj.S7: Five tiles laid in the square.
obj.S8: Twice a rule you have not played this week.
obj.L1: The first daily puzzle without a hint.
colecao.vazia: No tiles yet. Each day lays one, and the month makes the square.
regra.orla: As in Balance. The border takes half of each colour.
aviso.orla: The border passes half of one colour
intro.orla: Border: the rim of the square takes half of each colour.
tutorial.orla_anel: The outer ring counts apart. Half and half too.
artigo.PAC-RIA.desc: 20 Balance and Links puzzles, calm as the tide. Earned as Helper.
artigo.PAC-MOSTEIRO.desc: 20 puzzles with Mirror and the debut of Border. Earned as Journeyman.
artigo.PAC-AZULEJO-CALCADA.desc: 20 large puzzles with every rule. Earned as Master.
artigo.MOLD-MESTRE.desc: A frame only for those who reach Master. Not for sale.
artigo.SOM-PEDRA.desc: The sound as always: stone settling on stone. Included for everyone.
artigo.SOM-SINO.desc: The stone settles and, far off, a village bell rings.
artigo.PEDRA-ARDOSIA.desc: Chips of grey slate, thin and cool to the touch.
artigo.PEDRA-GRANITO.desc: Granite from the North, coarse-grained and rain-coloured.
artigo.PEDRA-LIOZ.desc: Lisbon's pale limestone, with a golden vein. A rare stone.
artigo.PAL-RIA.desc: Sea green and sand, like the ria at the end of the day.
artigo.PAL-MOSTEIRO.desc: Cloister stone and old gold. A rare palette.
artigo.MOLD-CAIS.desc: Quayside ropes and moorings around the square.
artigo.MOLD-AZULEJO.desc: A frame of blue and white azulejo tiles around the square.
artigo.SELO-2.desc: Earned on reaching Helper. Not for sale.
artigo.SELO-3.desc: Earned on reaching Paver. Not for sale.
artigo.SELO-4.desc: Earned on reaching Journeyman. Not for sale.
artigo.SELO-5.desc: Earned on reaching Master. Not for sale.
artigo.SOM-MADEIRA.desc: The sound of a wooden mallet tapping the stone.
artigo.SOM-AGUA.desc: The stone settling, with water in the background.
loja.lascas_intro: Chips are earned by playing. If you are in a hurry, you can buy them too.
loja.lascas_guardadas: Chips you buy are kept in your game account.
loja.lascas_credito: You have {antes} chips; you will have {depois}.
loja.lascas_creditadas: Chips added: you had {antes}, you have {depois}.
loja.lascas_fechadas: Sign in and wait for the sync: that way the chips you buy are never lost.
loja.lascas_a_sincronizar: Syncing your account. Buying chips opens as soon as it is done.
loja.nao_vende: Not for sale. Earned by playing.
dia.fim.1: One more tile laid. The joint is left to dry.
dia.fim.2: Day done. The square grew by one tile.
dia.fim.3: Stone by stone. Today it was this one.
dia.fim.4: It is laid. Tomorrow picks up from here.
dia.fim.5: The ground is better than you found it.
dia.fim.6: A stone in place is a stone in place.
dia.fim.pistas: A little help lays stones well too.
dia.fim.rapido: That was quick. Some days are like that.
marco.primeira_praca: The first square is done. You can stroll through it.
marco.seguidos7: Seven days in a row. The paving is grateful, no rush.
marco.seguidos30: A month of days. The ground already bears your hand.
marco.primeiro_largo: The first plaza is complete. Others are waiting.
praca.fim: Month closed. The square is yours.
regresso.2: Everything is as you left it. Stones are in no hurry.
regresso.3: There is a tile waiting for you in the plaza.
regresso.4: The ground held. Pick up where you left off.
regresso.longo: Time has passed. The joint held. Come back whenever you like.
regresso.puzzle: A puzzle was left half done. You pick up where you were.
largo.rossio: Rossio. Black and white waves to the end of the plaza.
largo.ribeira: Ribeira. The river and the quay, in stone.
rank.intro: Compare your ground with anyone you like. No scores, no rush.
rank.codigo_invalido: That code does not look right. Check it and try again.
rank.vazio: You have not added anyone yet. Share your code and compare craft, streaks and squares done.
rank.local_nota: Stays only on this phone and the ones you choose. Nothing goes to servers.
rank.global_breve: A table for everyone may come later.
rank.sem_rede: No connection. Showing what you had.
rank.sequencia_cuidado: Days in a row only count without hints, as in sharing.
caminho.menu_sub: Always free. Every level gives chips.
caminho.hoje_teto: Today: {ganhas}/{teto} chips. Carry on as you like.
caminho.saltado: Level skipped. It will come back, in good time.
caminho.teto_dia: You already have today's chips. The next levels are just for the pleasure.
caminho.loja_faltam: {n} chips short. Play the Path: you earn up to {teto} a day.
caminho.sem_pistas: No hints. One costs {preco} chips in the Shop, or you carry on without.
obj.L13: Solve 25 Balance puzzles without a hint.
obj.L14: Solve 25 Links puzzles without a hint.
obj.L15: Solve 25 Mirror puzzles without a hint.
obj.L16: Solve 25 Border puzzles without a hint.
obj.L17: Solve 40 puzzles needing technique N2, no hint.
obj.L18: Solve 25 puzzles needing technique N3, no hint.
obj.L22: Complete the month's square 3 months running.
obj.L23: Complete the month's square 6 months running.
obj.L27: Golden times: one puzzle of each difficulty, no hint, within the time.
artigo.MOLD-CENTO.desc: Earned by solving 500 puzzles without a hint. Not for sale.
artigo.MOLD-TRIMESTRE.desc: Earned with three months running of a complete square. Not for sale.
artigo.MOLD-ANO.desc: Earned with twelve month squares. Not for sale.
artigo.PEDRA-ESTACOES.desc: Earned by completing all six Seasons. Not for sale.
artigo.SELO-100.desc: Earned by solving 100 puzzles without a hint. Not for sale.
artigo.SELO-AMIGOS.desc: Earned by adding three friends. Not for sale.
artigo.PEDRA-XISTO.desc: Earned on reaching Paver. Not for sale.
artigo.PEDRA-CORTICA.desc: Earned with three months running of a complete square. Not for sale.
artigo.PEDRA-AREIA.desc: Earned by completing a puzzle pack. Not for sale.
artigo.PAL-ESTUARIO.desc: Earned by solving 40 N2 technique puzzles without a hint. Not for sale.
artigo.PAL-OLIVAL.desc: Earned with six months running of a complete square. Not for sale.
artigo.MOLD-PINHAL.desc: Earned by solving 100 puzzles without a hint. Not for sale.
quadro.nota: Only you see this. It stays on this phone.
quadro.puzzles: Puzzles solved: {sem} without hint, {com} with hint
desafio.nota: Paste a challenge code. Nothing goes to servers.
desafio.so_convite: Invitation only (with a hint there is no time).
desafio.desconhecido: This puzzle does not exist here yet.
desafio.escondido: The time stays hidden until you solve it.
dica.metas: The big goals take months. No rush, your progress is saved.
dica.quadro: Here is your board. Paste a code to accept a challenge.
regresso.tens_ca: You are {nivel}. It is all here.
resumo.vazio: Once there is a week with play, the summary shows up here.
lembrete.recusado: You can turn it on in your phone settings.
lembrete.indisponivel: This phone does not support reminders yet.
loja.ver_aviso: It is only a sample. It spends no chips and changes nothing in your game.
loja.ver_ouvir_mudo: Sound is off. Turn it on in Settings to listen.
colecao.vazio_falta: Nothing is missing here. You have it all.
artigo.PAC-SAZ-AAAA-Q.desc: Twenty puzzles with the season's weather. Earned by playing or traded for chips, and yours with no deadline.
colecao.mold_mes.01: January. The star of the carol singers.
colecao.mold_mes.02: February. The almond tree in bloom.
colecao.mold_mes.03: March. Fine rain on the paving.
colecao.mold_mes.06: June. A basil pot at the window.
colecao.mold_mes.07: July. The sun beats on white stone.
colecao.mold_mes.08: August. A shell on the sand.
colecao.mold_mes.10: October. A leaf falls in the plaza.
colecao.mold_mes.11: November. Hot chestnuts in your hand.
colecao.mold_mes.12: December. A pine closes the year.
anuncio.ver_troco: Watch an ad: double chips (~30 s)
anuncio.fechado_cedo: The ad closed before the end, so there is no reward this time.
anuncio.privacidade_nota: You can review your consent whenever you like.
anuncio.removidos: Ads turned off. Rewards carry on, without you seeing anything.
loja.sa_ativo: You already have: no ads. Thank you!
loja.sa_sem_preco: Price unavailable right now. Check your connection and try again; or use Restore purchases.
loja.sa_sem_play: Buying is only available in the app installed from Google Play.
retorno.hoje: Good to see you. There is a new puzzle today.
retorno.7: Everything is as you left it: the square, the chips, the trimmings. Start wherever you fancy.
retorno.sugestao: To ease back in, a light puzzle
retorno.serie_nota: It stays saved. Start another whenever you like.
retorno.recomecar_feito: New streak. One day at a time.
tutorial.metas_longas: There are long-term goals: techniques, squares, months. No rush at all.
tutorial.metas_ver: Goals live in the Path. They give only chips and trimmings, never an advantage.
tutorial.desafio_codigo: You can challenge a friend with a code. They paste it, play, and see if they beat your time.
tutorial.desafio_privado: It carries only the puzzle and the time. Nothing goes to servers.
tutorial3.p3_meta: Without a hint, it counts toward your goal.
tutorial3.meta_subiu: One more stone toward your goal.
tutorial3.meta_com_pista: Solved. The goal counts the ones you do without a hint.
tutorial3.amigo_texto: Without a hint, you get a code. A friend tries to beat your time.
feedback.texto_rotulo: What would you like to tell us?
feedback.dados_aviso: We will attach technical data from the device (model, Android, screen). Nothing that identifies you.
feedback.dados_lista: We send: game and version, model, Android, screen size, margins, navigation, language and the open screen.
feedback.ok: Thank you! It has reached the studio.
feedback.limite: You have sent a lot today. Try tomorrow.
contaui.intro: One account for all games. Your progress goes with you.
contaui.obrig_nota: You need an account to play. Your progress is saved in the cloud.
contaui.criar_intro: We will send you a link to confirm your email. The account only becomes active once you confirm.
contaui.criar_nota: This device's progress moves to the account.
contaui.confirmar: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it and come back here to sign in.
contaui.rec_ok: If the email exists, we sent a link to {email}.
contaui.eliminar_aviso: This deletes the account and the progress saved in the cloud, in all Companha games. It cannot be undone.
contaui.eliminar_google: You will confirm again with Google.
contaui.saiu: Signed out. Your progress stays on this device.
contaui.conf_intro: The cloud and this device have different progress. The other version is kept so you can undo.
contaui.reenviado: We sent another confirmation link to {email}.
contaui.privac_obrig: Accept the privacy policy to create the account.
contaui.sinc.inativo.detalhe: progress stays only on this device
contaui.sinc.ok.detalhe: your progress is in the cloud
contaui.sinc.offline.detalhe: saved on device; syncs when back
contaui.sinc.limite.detalhe: over 50 KB; kept only on this device
contaui.erro.rede: No connection. Try again when you have a network.
contaui.erro.email_existe: An account with this email already exists.
contaui.erro.password_fraca: Weak password: use 8 or more characters.
contaui.erro.cancelado: You cancelled the Google sign-in. Tap again whenever you like.
contaui.erro.google_indisponivel: Google sign-in is not available in this version yet. Use email and password.
contaui.erro.google_sem_conta: I could not find a Google account on this phone. Add one in Settings or use email.
contaui.erro.google_falhou: Could not sign in with Google. Try again or use email.
contaui.erro.sem_sessao: Your session ended. Sign in again.
contaui.erro.limite: Progress is too large for the cloud.
contaui.erro.muitos_pedidos: Too many requests in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again.
contaui.erro.email_nao_confirmado: You have not confirmed your email yet. Open the link we sent you or ask for another.
